why.settings.enabledPlugins: turns on the academic research, DeepEval and Hugging Face plugins for this repo
why.settings.extraKnownMarketplaces: declares the academic research plugin's marketplace, so Claude Code offers it to everyone who clones this repo

notes: Prefer the targeted ARS modes (/ars-lit-review, /ars-citation-check, /ars-reviewer); a full /ars-full pipeline run uses a lot of plan usage (or API credits, if you pay per token). Literature search: the claude.ai Wiley Scholar Gateway connector, or the deep-research skill. Without a claude.ai login, enable the wiley-scholar-gateway@life-sciences plugin instead (not both).
